pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance' means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance:
SECTION 2. (1) A food vendor may not use a polystyrene foam container in selling, offering for sale, serving or dispensing prepared food to a consumer.
SECTION 3. A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state polystyrene foam containers or polystyrene foam packaging peanuts.
SECTION 4. A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.
